review_scope: Narrow executable F3/F3a migration re-review; no production fix applied

F3.reason: The original qualified-path reproducer passes, but the semantic-preservation claim still fails for shadowed concord paths and bare reserved format names.

F3a.reason: Scoped, cfg-disabled, line-commented and block-commented Concord imports no longer remap a downstream bare Text.

new_findings.summary: Unrooted concord:: marker paths can bind a local module or import alias, yet word() changes them to the canonical Concord marker.
new_findings.evidence: On both toolchains, controls send CUSTOM:value/application/x-custom and use the custom decoder; migrated declarations instead use built-in Text/Json/Binary wire and decoder behaviour.
new_findings.recommendation: Keep unrooted concord:: paths unless their canonical binding is established; add shadowing regressions.

new_findings.summary: Keeping bare lowercase text/json/bytes verbatim moves them into a position where the DSL parses a built-in word, changing the type.
new_findings.evidence: Both compiled forms succeed; custom wire body, content type and decoded value differ on stable and 1.85.1.
new_findings.recommendation: Qualify reserved bare format names as paths, e.g. self::text, when moving them out of via type position.

new_findings.summary: Preserved leading-:: renamed format paths fail in body position: ::c4::Text b: String reports expected identifier.
new_findings.evidence: Isolated migrated body and extern-alias body probes fail on both toolchains; absolute response paths compile. Absolute ::concord built-in paths pass after the script turns them into words.
new_findings.recommendation: Exclude leading :: paths from named-parameter lookahead; add absolute body format coverage.
new_findings.scope_note: A visible migration compatibility failure discovered in this check, not proven to have been introduced by b77084a.

oracle: Old via syntax is intentionally rejected by this snapshot. The old spelling was passed through the migration CLI; migrated output was compiled and compared to an explicit-path control resolving the intended original format in the same Rust scope. No old-version library build is claimed.
inspected_only: Supplied prior-review report, archived migration fixture generator, migration guide, existing formats test and REVIEW_TRIAGE; historical F1/F2/F4, broad verification, benchmarks and nightly claims were not rerun.
